item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 11 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 11 #VISPRSD
Issued at 07:55 PM 03 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NegrosOriental(Mabinay, CityOfBayawan, Pamplona), #Palawan(Dumaran, ElNido), #Biliran(Culaba, Caibiran and Kawayan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
